Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error by prematurely concluding the task and providing an incorrect solution, prioritizing a mechanical approach over the obvious magnetic separation method without adequately analyzing the properties of magnets in separating aluminum and steel screws. Although aluminum is paramagnetic and weakly attracted to strong magnets, steel screws typically contain ferrous materials that are strongly magnetic. This oversight aligns with patterns seen in Example 1, where the Planner dismissed the most applicable option due to an initial bias and did not leverage broader specialist capabilities to verify the assumption.
